description: A React component managing user data, including CRUD operations for admin users. It handles fetching user lists, user details, creating, editing, deleting users, and managing UI modes.

methods.name: loadUsers
methods.description: Fetches the list of users and updates the state.

methods.name: loadRoles
methods.description: Fetches the list of roles for dropdowns.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a user to view details.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Prepares the form for editing a selected user.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new user.

methods.name: handleSubmitCreate
methods.description: Submits the form data to create a new user.

methods.name: handleSubmitEdit
methods.description: Submits the form data to update an existing user.

methods.name: handleCancelForm
methods.description: Cancels the current form and returns to list mode.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Prepares to delete a user, shows confirmation.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Confirms deletion of user and updates list.
